subject.title: Device pairing: bind setup codes to node approvals

question: Should this protected maintainer PR be closed as superseded by the current profile-based setup-code bootstrap contract, or rebuilt on top of that contract?
rationale: The branch touches an authorization boundary, is live-conflicting, and conflicts with later merged setup-code/QR handoff work; automation should not choose the permanent security contract for maintainers.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR and keep the profile-based contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83684 plus https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85690 as the canonical implementation.

options.title: Rebuild on current main
options.body: Ask for a fresh PR that preserves `PAIRING_SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_PROFILE`, `profile/redeemedProfile/pendingProfile`, and the existing gateway/mobile tests.

options.title: Intentionally restore node-only setup codes
options.body: Only choose this if maintainers explicitly want to drop the bounded operator handoff and accept the native onboarding compatibility impact.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR and keep the profile-based contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83684 plus https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85690 as the canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the canonical merged handoff and later scope-hardening PRs that define the current security boundary.
